entries.title: MATLAB, Symbolic Math Toolbox, Control System Toolbox, Simulink and Simscape reference pages (release R2026b)
entries.venue: https://www.mathworks.com/help/ — symbolic/sym.diff.html, symbolic/sym.functionalderivative.html, symbolic/syms.html, symbolic/sym.html, symbolic/sym.subs.html, symbolic/sym.simplify.html, symbolic/sym.solve.html, symbolic/sym.jacobian.html, symbolic/sym.odetovectorfield.html, symbolic/sym.matlabfunction.html, matlab/ref/ode45.html, matlab/ref/eig.html, matlab/ref/double.linspace.html, matlab/ref/plot.html, control/ref/ss.html, control/ref/tf.html, control/ref/dynamicsystem.step.html, control/ref/dynamicsystem.initial.html, control/ref/dynamicsystem.lsim.html, control/ref/dynamicsystem.bode.html, control/ref/dynamicsystem.damp.html, simulink/slref/integrator.html, simulink/slref/gain.html, simulink/slref/sum.html, simulink/slref/fcn.html, simulink/slref/matlabfunction.html, simulink/slref/sinewave.html, simulink/slref/scope.html, simulink/slref/mux.html, simscape/ref/mass.html, simscape/ref/translationalspring.html, simscape/ref/translationaldamper.html, simscape/ref/idealforcesource.html, simscape/ref/solverconfiguration.html, sm/ref/revolutejoint.html; read 7 Nov 2026
entries.backs: The calls in src/labs/matlab.js and the lab modules: diff(f, diff(x(t),t)) is documented (the diff page's own Euler–Lagrange example); odeToVectorField orders the states Y[1] = y, Y[2] = y' and returns the order as S, and the page's workflow is matlabFunction(V,'vars',{'t','Y'}) then ode45; ode45 wants odefun(t,y) returning a column and gives one row of y per time; eig(A,B) solves A*V = B*V*D, so eig(K,M) gives λ = ω²; bode's magnitude is a ratio, 1×1×N, to be squeezed; tf('s') builds s; jacobian(f,v) has ∂f(i)/∂v(j) at (i,j); subs does not change its argument; the Sum block's signs list one sign per input; the Integrator's initial condition defaults to 0; the Sine Wave block's frequency is in rad/s. Not read, used in their common forms only: arrayfun(@(om) …, w), trace, det, double, abs, squeeze, sqrt, diag, xlabel, ylabel, legend. Read as: web pages, read and summarised by a helper agent; not re-read word for word.

entries.title: SciPy 1.18 reference pages: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp, scipy.linalg.eig
entries.backs: solve_ivp(fun, t_span, y0, method='RK45') with rtol 1e-3 and atol 1e-6 by default, sol.y of shape (n, n_points); eig(a, b) solves a v = w b v, w complex, no order promised (the installed version returned 3000 before 500 for the TM3 note's K and M, so the snippets sort).

entries.title: SymPy reference: solvers (solve), Function, diff
entries.backs: solve([eqs], [symbols], dict=True) returns a list of solution dicts; used to get the accelerations from the Lagrange equations (sympy has no odeToVectorField). diff by a derivative, diff(L, diff(x, t)), was checked by running it in the installed SymPy 1.14.

entries.title: python-control 0.10.2 reference pages: control.matlab.step, ss, tf, frequency_response
entries.venue: https://python-control.readthedocs.io/en/0.10.2/generated/control.matlab.step.html and the module index; read 7 Nov 2026
entries.backs: ss, step (returns y, t as MATLAB's [y,t]), tf('s'), dcgain and frequency_response in src/labs/python.js; bode's old return of mag, phase, omega is deprecated in 0.10.2 (a FutureWarning when run), so the snippets use frequency_response.
